requirements.text: Front-desk staff can suspend online booking for a single clinician for a date range without changing the PMS rota.
requirements.quote: Front-desk staff shall be able to suspend online booking for a single clinician for a date range, for example during unplanned leave, without changing the PMS rota.

requirements.text: The portal provides a monthly per-site report of appointments booked, moved and cancelled online, reminders sent, and missed appointments for online and telephone bookings separately.
requirements.quote: The portal shall provide a monthly report for each site showing the number of appointments booked, moved and cancelled online, the number of reminders sent, and the number of missed appointments for online and telephone bookings separately.

requirements.text: The portal is available at least 99.5% of the time each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced at least five days ahead.
requirements.quote: The portal shall be available at least 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced at least five days in advance.

requirements.text: Availability searches return within three seconds for 95% of requests at peak load.
requirements.quote: Availability searches shall return results within three seconds for 95% of requests at peak load.

requirements.text: The patient-facing portal meets WCAG 2.2 AA.
requirements.quote: The patient-facing portal shall meet the WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standard.

requirements.text: The portal is available in English and other commonly spoken languages where possible.
requirements.quote: The portal shall be available in English and in the other languages most commonly spoken by registered patients, where possible.

requirements.text: The portal stores only the personal data needed for sign-in and reminders and reads other patient details from the PMS when needed.
requirements.quote: The portal shall store only the personal data needed to sign patients in and to send reminders, and shall read all other patient details from the PMS when they are needed.

requirements.text: Every booking, change and cancellation is recorded in an audit log showing who, on whose behalf, and when.
requirements.quote: Every booking, change and cancellation made through the portal shall be recorded in an audit log showing who made it, on whose behalf, and when.

requirements.text: Audit log entries are kept for eight years and cannot be edited by any user, including system administrators.
requirements.quote: Audit log entries shall be kept for eight years and shall not be editable by any user, including system administrators.

requirements.text: Portal accounts unused for two years are deleted, with an email warning thirty days beforehand; the PMS record is unaffected.
requirements.quote: Portal accounts that have not been used for two years shall be deleted, and the patient shall be warned by email thirty days before deletion.

questions.text: How long is the inactivity period before a session ends, and how long before expiry is the warning shown? The open issues list says it is not agreed (10 minutes suggested, patient reps felt too short).
questions.quote: The workshop did not reach a conclusion on how long the period should be.

questions.text: Which second factor is used at sign-in on a new device (code to the PMS mobile number, authenticator app, other)? And how is the sign-in email address captured and verified during account creation, which only lists date of birth, surname, postcode and a one-time code?
questions.quote: A patient shall sign in with an email address and password, and the portal shall require a second factor on every sign-in from a device it has not seen before.

questions.text: How often, by whom, and with what outcome are adult dependant carer links reviewed? What happens to a link if the review is not done?
questions.quote: Links for adult dependants, for example a patient with a lasting power of attorney in place, are reviewed periodically.

questions.text: Section 5.1 limits the portal to appointment types bookable at the patient's registered site, with cross-site exceptions only for physiotherapy and travel health, while the open issues say cross-site routine GP booking is undecided (2 for, 4 against). What is the rule for launch for booking at other sites, and for which appointment types?
questions.quote: Patients registered at one site can be seen at another site for some services, such as physiotherapy, which is only offered at two sites.

questions.text: What is the measurable meaning of 'near real time' (maximum delay between a PMS change, such as a telephone booking, and the portal showing it)? How is double booking prevented when a slot is booked by phone in that gap?
questions.quote: Availability shown in the portal shall reflect the PMS appointment book in near real time.

questions.text: What should the portal do when the PMS is unavailable or rejects the booking (message to patient, retry, slot hold, fallback to telephone)?
questions.quote: If the PMS is unavailable, the booking should be handled appropriately.

questions.text: Cancellation through the portal is allowed up to two hours before the start, but reminder-link cancellation has no stated cut-off. Does the two-hour limit apply to cancellation via reminders, and what can patients do inside two hours?
questions.quote: A patient shall be able to cancel an appointment through the portal up to two hours before its start time.

questions.text: The text reminder is specified as 48 hours before, but the notification table says 24 hours before (and today's reminders go the day before). Which is correct? Is the physiotherapy 7am same-day text in addition to the standard reminder?
questions.quote: The portal shall send each patient a reminder by text message 48 hours before every appointment, whether it was booked online or by telephone.

questions.text: What is the expiry period for a waiting list offer? The open issues say it is to be confirmed by practice managers. What does 'short' mean in minutes or hours, and does it vary when the slot is close to its start time?
questions.quote: An offer shall expire if it is not accepted within a short period, and the slot shall then be offered to the next patient on the list.

questions.text: Should front-desk staff see the patient's reason for appointment at all? The clinical leads have questioned this, yet the staff list assumes it is shown. Which is the decision?
questions.quote: Front-desk staff shall be able to see a list of the day's online bookings, cancellations and waiting list offers for their site, with the reason for appointment given by each patient.

questions.text: Which languages must be supported at launch? 'Where possible' leaves this open and Polish, Urdu and Somali are unconfirmed. Who decides what is possible, and will registration data be used to confirm?
questions.quote: The portal shall be available in English and in the other languages most commonly spoken by registered patients, where possible.

requirements.text: A handler can register a claim from an email, a telephone note passed on by customer service, or a completed claim form, and the application records the channel and the date and time the claim was first notified.
requirements.quote: A handler shall be able to register a claim from an email, a telephone note passed on by customer service, or a completed claim form, and the application shall record the channel and the date and time the claim was first notified.

requirements.text: The application requires the consignment note number at registration and retrieves the consignment's details from the operational tracking system, including dates, depots, exceptions and proof of delivery.
requirements.quote: The application shall require the consignment note number when a claim is registered and shall retrieve the consignment's details from the operational tracking system, including the collection and delivery dates, the depots it passed through, any exceptions recorded and the proof of delivery.

requirements.text: If the consignment note number is not found, the handler can register the claim with the consignment marked unverified, and the application blocks any payment until the consignment is verified.
requirements.quote: If the consignment note number cannot be found in the tracking system, the handler shall be able to register the claim with the consignment marked as unverified, and the application shall prevent any payment on the claim until the consignment has been verified.

requirements.text: One claim can cover several consignments for the same claimant, with loss type and amount claimed recorded separately for each consignment.
requirements.quote: A single claim shall be able to cover several consignments for the same claimant, and the application shall record the loss type and amount claimed separately for each consignment.

requirements.text: The application warns the handler when a new claim is registered for a consignment that already has an open or closed claim, and shows the existing claim.
requirements.quote: The application shall warn the handler when a new claim is registered for a consignment that already has an open or closed claim, and shall show the existing claim.

requirements.text: The application calculates for each consignment whether the claim was notified within the time limit in the claimant's terms and flags late-notified claims.
requirements.quote: The application shall calculate, for each consignment on a claim, whether the claim was notified within the time limit in the claimant's terms, and shall flag any claim notified late.

requirements.text: Under the standard conditions, damage and shortage must be notified within 7 days of delivery and loss within 28 days of the expected delivery date; special terms may set different periods.
requirements.quote: Under the standard conditions, damage and shortage must be notified within 7 days of delivery and loss within 28 days of the expected delivery date.

requirements.text: A late-notified claim is not rejected automatically; the handler records whether the time limit is enforced and the reason if it is waived.
requirements.quote: A late-notified claim shall not be rejected automatically; the handler shall record whether the time limit is being enforced and, if it is waived, the reason for the waiver.

requirements.text: The application maintains the list of required documents per loss type, and the claims operations manager can change the list without a software release.
requirements.quote: The application shall maintain the list of documents required for each loss type, and the claims operations manager shall be able to change the list without a software release.

requirements.text: On registration the application generates a request to the claimant listing the documents required for each consignment.
requirements.quote: When a claim is registered, the application shall generate a request to the claimant listing the documents required for each consignment on the claim.

requirements.text: A handler can attach documents from email, from a file, or by forwarding to a claim-specific address, and the application records who attached each document and when.
requirements.quote: A handler shall be able to attach documents to a claim from email, from a file, or by forwarding an email to a claim-specific address, and the application shall record who attached each document and when.

requirements.text: A claim cannot proceed to approval until every required document is received or the handler has recorded why it is not needed.
requirements.quote: The application shall not allow a claim to proceed to approval until every required document has been received or the handler has recorded why it is not needed.

requirements.text: A reminder is sent 21 days after the document request if documents are missing, and the claim is closed as abandoned if still not received 21 days after the reminder.
requirements.quote: If the required documents have not been received 21 days after the request, the application shall send a reminder to the claimant, and if they have still not been received 21 days after the reminder, the claim shall be closed as abandoned.

requirements.text: An abandoned claim can be reopened if the documents arrive later.
requirements.quote: An abandoned claim can be reopened if the documents arrive later.

requirements.text: A handler can request an independent inspection for a damage claim, record the surveyor appointed, and attach the surveyor's report.
requirements.quote: The handler shall be able to request an independent inspection for a damage claim, record the surveyor appointed, and attach the surveyor's report.

requirements.text: An inspection must be requested for every damage claim on a high-value consignment before liability is decided.
requirements.quote: An inspection shall be requested for every damage claim on a high-value consignment before liability is decided.

requirements.text: The handler records a liability decision per consignment (accepted, partly accepted or declined) with a reason from a list maintained by the claims operations manager.
requirements.quote: The handler shall record a liability decision for each consignment on a claim, chosen from accepted, partly accepted or declined, with a reason chosen from a list maintained by the claims operations manager.

requirements.text: For declined or partly accepted decisions on inadequate packaging, the handler must attach supporting evidence before the decision can be saved.
requirements.quote: Where the liability decision is declined or partly accepted on the grounds of inadequate packaging, the handler shall attach the evidence supporting that decision before the decision can be saved.

requirements.text: The application shows the handler the depot exceptions recorded for the consignment.
requirements.quote: The application shall show the handler the depot exceptions recorded for the consignment, so that the handler can see where in the network the loss or damage was first recorded.

requirements.text: Where a subcontracted haulier carried the consignment on any leg, the application identifies the haulier and leg from the tracking system and records them on the claim.
requirements.quote: Where the consignment was carried by a subcontracted haulier on any leg, the application shall identify the haulier and the leg from the tracking system and shall record them on the claim.

requirements.text: The application calculates the limit of liability per consignment from the weight of goods lost or damaged and the per-kilogram limit in the claimant's terms.
requirements.quote: The application shall calculate the limit of liability for each consignment from the weight of the goods lost or damaged and the per-kilogram limit in the claimant's terms.

requirements.text: Where a value was declared and the declared value charge paid, the declared value is the limit of liability instead of the per-kilogram limit.
requirements.quote: Where the claimant declared a value for the consignment and paid the declared value charge, the limit of liability shall be the declared value instead of the per-kilogram limit.

requirements.text: Where special terms apply, the application uses their limits, and a handler cannot override the calculated limit without the claims operations manager's approval.
requirements.quote: Where special terms apply, the application shall use the limits in the special terms, and the handler shall not be able to override the calculated limit without the approval of the claims operations manager.

requirements.text: The amount payable per consignment is the lower of the proven value of the loss and the limit of liability, less any salvage value recovered.
requirements.quote: The amount payable for a consignment shall be the lower of the proven value of the loss and the limit of liability, less any salvage value recovered from damaged goods.

requirements.text: The application shows the handler a step-by-step calculation of the amount payable, and the same explanation is included in the settlement letter.
requirements.quote: The application shall show the handler how the amount payable was calculated, step by step, and the same explanation shall be included in the settlement letter to the claimant.

requirements.text: Consequential losses are not payable under the standard conditions, and the application prevents a handler including them unless special terms allow.
requirements.quote: Consequential losses, such as lost profit or the cost of a missed production run, shall not be payable under the standard conditions, and the application shall prevent a handler from including them in the amount payable unless special terms allow them.

requirements.text: A delay claim is payable only where the claimant had a guaranteed delivery service, and the amount cannot exceed the carriage charge.
requirements.quote: A delay claim shall only be payable where the claimant had a guaranteed delivery service, and the amount payable shall not exceed the carriage charge for the consignment.

requirements.text: The handler can approve a settlement of up to 1,000.
requirements.quote: The handler managing the claim can approve a settlement of up to 1,000.

requirements.text: A regional desk team leader must approve settlements from 1,000 to 10,000.
requirements.quote: A team leader on the regional desk must approve a settlement from 1,000 to 10,000.

requirements.text: The claims operations manager must approve settlements from 10,000 to 50,000.
requirements.quote: The claims operations manager must approve a settlement from 10,000 to 50,000.

requirements.text: The finance director must approve settlements above 50,000, after legal department review.
requirements.quote: The finance director must approve a settlement above 50,000, after review by the legal department.

requirements.text: The application routes each settlement to the approver required by the matrix.
requirements.quote: The application shall route each settlement to the approver required by the matrix

requirements.text: A person cannot approve a settlement on a claim they registered or handled.
requirements.quote: shall not allow a person to approve a settlement on a claim they registered or handled.

requirements.text: The claims operations manager can configure the approval limits, and every change is recorded with who made it and the date.
requirements.quote: The approval limits in the matrix shall be configurable by the claims operations manager, and every change shall be recorded with the name of the person who made it and the date.

requirements.text: Once a settlement is approved the application generates a settlement letter showing the amount payable per consignment and how it was calculated.
requirements.quote: Once a settlement is approved, the application shall generate a settlement letter to the claimant showing the amount payable for each consignment and how it was calculated.

requirements.text: The application sends an approved payment to the finance ledger as a payment instruction with the claimant's account details and records the payment reference when finance confirms payment.
requirements.quote: The application shall send an approved payment to the finance ledger as a payment instruction with the claimant's account details, and shall record the payment reference when finance confirms the payment.

requirements.text: A claimant can accept or dispute a settlement, and a disputed settlement returns to the handler with the claimant's reasons.
requirements.quote: A claimant shall be able to accept the settlement or dispute it, and a disputed settlement shall return to the handler with the claimant's reasons.

requirements.text: A claim is closed when every consignment is paid, declined or withdrawn, and the application records the closing date and the outcome per consignment.
requirements.quote: A claim shall be closed when every consignment on it has been paid, declined or withdrawn, and the application shall record the closing date and the outcome for each consignment.

requirements.text: On settlement of a claim for a consignment carried by a subcontracted haulier, the application creates a linked recovery case if the amount paid exceeds the recovery threshold.
requirements.quote: When a claim is settled for a consignment carried by a subcontracted haulier, the application shall create a recovery case linked to the claim if the amount paid exceeds the recovery threshold.

requirements.text: The recovery case shows the time limit under the haulier's subcontract and alerts the recovery team 14 days before it expires.
requirements.quote: The recovery case shall show the time limit for making the recovery claim under the haulier's subcontract and shall alert the recovery team 14 days before it expires.

requirements.text: The recovery team can record the amount claimed, the haulier's response and the amount recovered, and the application shows the net cost of the original claim after recovery.
requirements.quote: The recovery team shall be able to record the amount claimed from the haulier, the haulier's response, and the amount recovered, and the application shall show the net cost of the original claim after recovery.

requirements.text: The recovery team can deduct an agreed recovery amount from the haulier's next payment, and the application sends the deduction to the finance ledger as an instruction.
requirements.quote: The recovery team shall be able to deduct an agreed recovery amount from the next payment to the haulier, and the application shall send the deduction to the finance ledger as an instruction.

requirements.text: The application identifies settled claims whose amount paid exceeds the insurance policy excess and produces, for any period, the schedule in the insurer's required format.
requirements.quote: The application shall identify every settled claim whose amount paid exceeds the insurance policy excess and shall produce, for any period, the schedule of those claims in the format the insurer requires.

requirements.text: The application records the amount recovered from the insurer against each claim in the schedule.
requirements.quote: The application shall record the amount recovered from the insurer against each claim in the schedule.

requirements.text: The application emails the claimant when the claim is registered, documents are requested, liability is decided, a settlement is approved and the claim is closed.
requirements.quote: The application shall send the claimant an email when their claim is registered, when documents are requested, when liability is decided, when a settlement is approved and when the claim is closed.

requirements.text: Every message to the claimant quotes the claim reference and handler name and is sent from a reply-able address.
requirements.quote: Every message to the claimant shall quote the claim reference and the name of the handler managing the claim, and shall be sent from an address to which the claimant can reply.

requirements.text: Claimant replies are attached to the claim automatically and the handler is notified.
requirements.quote: Replies from claimants shall be attached to the claim automatically and the handler shall be notified.

requirements.text: Customer service staff can see any claim's status and message history but cannot change a claim.
requirements.quote: Customer service staff shall be able to see the status of any claim and its history of messages, but shall not be able to change a claim.

requirements.text: The application reports, for any period and by region, claims notified, settled, average time to settlement, total claimed, total paid and total recovered.
requirements.quote: The application shall report, for any period and by region, the number of claims notified, the number settled, the average time from notification to settlement, the total amount claimed, the total amount paid and the total amount recovered.

requirements.text: The application reports claims open more than 30 days with their stage and time at that stage.
requirements.quote: The application shall report the claims that have been open for more than 30 days, with the stage each one is at and how long it has been at that stage.

requirements.text: The application reports recovery cases expiring within 30 days that have not been submitted to the haulier.
requirements.quote: The application shall report recovery cases whose time limit expires in the next 30 days and have not yet been submitted to the haulier.

requirements.text: Finance can reconcile ledger payments against approved settlements for any period.
requirements.quote: Finance shall be able to reconcile the payments recorded in the ledger against the settlements approved in the application for any period.

requirements.text: Access to claims is restricted by role, and handlers can see claims of every region.
requirements.quote: Access to claims shall be restricted by role, and handlers shall see the claims of every region so that work can be moved between desks when one is busy.

requirements.text: Every change to a claim is recorded with who made it and the date and time, and the record cannot be edited.
requirements.quote: Every change to a claim, including changes to amounts, liability decisions and approvals, shall be recorded with the person who made it and the date and time, and the record shall not be editable.

requirements.text: Claim records and documents are retained for seven years after closure and then deleted, unless the claim is subject to litigation.
requirements.quote: Claim records and their documents shall be retained for seven years after the claim is closed and then deleted, unless the claim is subject to litigation.

requirements.text: All claims open on the regional spreadsheets at go-live are migrated with status, amounts and mailbox documents.
requirements.quote: All claims open on the regional spreadsheets at go-live shall be migrated into the application with their status, amounts and the documents held in the mailbox.

requirements.text: Claims closed in the twelve months before go-live are migrated.
requirements.quote: Claims closed in the twelve months before go-live shall be migrated so that duplicate claim warnings and reporting cover them.

requirements.text: The application is available 99.5% of the time during 7am to 7pm on working days.
requirements.quote: The application shall be available during the claims desks' working hours, from 7am to 7pm on working days, at least 99.5% of the time.

requirements.text: The application supports at least 40 concurrent users with no page taking more than three seconds to load.
requirements.quote: The application shall support at least 40 concurrent users without any page taking more than three seconds to load.

requirements.text: The application is usable by handlers working from home through the company's standard remote access.
requirements.quote: The application shall be usable by handlers working from home through the company's standard remote access arrangements.

questions.text: The notification limit for damage or shortage is 7 days in section 5.2 but 14 days in the section 15 summary. Section 15 says the capability sections take precedence, but the summary was also reviewed by legal. Which figure is correct, and should the summary be corrected?
questions.quote: | Notice of damage or shortage | Within 14 days of delivery |

questions.text: Who may waive the notification time limit, and is any approval needed? Commercial managers ask for waivers, but the document only says the handler records the waiver and its reason.
questions.quote: the handler shall record whether the time limit is being enforced and, if it is waived, the reason for the waiver.

questions.text: No notification time limit is given for delay claims, although delay is in scope. Is there a limit, and does the late-notification check apply to delay claims?
questions.quote: The standard conditions require the claimant to give notice of damage or shortage within a set time after delivery, and notice of loss within a set time after the expected delivery date.

questions.text: 'High-value consignment' is undefined and its definition is still to be agreed. What is the threshold, and is it configurable? The mandatory inspection rule cannot be built or tested without it.
questions.quote: An inspection shall be requested for every damage claim on a high-value consignment before liability is decided.

questions.text: What is the recovery threshold, and is it a fixed value or configurable? It has not been agreed between finance and the recovery team, yet it decides when a recovery case is created.
questions.quote: the application shall create a recovery case linked to the claim if the amount paid exceeds the recovery threshold.

questions.text: The matrix lets the handler approve up to 1,000 on their own claim, but the rule says no one may approve a claim they registered or handled. Which prevails? If the handler cannot self-approve, who approves settlements up to 1,000?
questions.quote: shall not allow a person to approve a settlement on a claim they registered or handled.

questions.text: The matrix bands overlap at 1,000, 10,000 and 50,000 ('up to 1,000' and 'from 1,000 to 10,000'). Which approver applies at exactly those amounts? Also, what currency are the amounts in?
questions.quote: A team leader on the regional desk must approve a settlement from 1,000 to 10,000.

questions.text: 'Promptly' has no measurable time. Is there a maximum time for approvers to act, and should the application escalate or report overdue approvals, given the 30-day settlement goal?
questions.quote: Approvers are expected to deal with approvals promptly so that settlement times can be met.

questions.text: How long does a claimant have to accept or dispute a settlement, and what happens if they do not respond? Can a settlement be disputed more than once?
questions.quote: A claimant shall be able to accept the settlement or dispute it, and a disputed settlement shall return to the handler with the claimant's reasons.

questions.text: Is the legal department's request that document access be no wider than claim access an agreed requirement? Handlers can see all regions' claims, so clarify whether documents containing prices or photographs of people need any further restriction.
questions.quote: The legal department has asked that access to documents be no wider than access to claims.

questions.text: May customer service register claims directly? This is undecided, yet registration is described as a handler function and customer service is read-only.
questions.quote: Whether customer service may register claims directly, rather than passing them to the mailbox, has been raised but not decided.

questions.text: Do the 21-day periods for the reminder and abandonment count calendar days or working days?
questions.quote: If the required documents have not been received 21 days after the request, the application shall send a reminder to the claimant

requirements.text: A grants officer can create a round recording its dates and times, budget, minimum and maximum grant, eligibility questions, application questions and weighted assessment criteria.
requirements.quote: A grants officer shall be able to create a round for a programme, recording its opening and closing date and time, its budget, the minimum and maximum grant that can be requested, the eligibility questions, the application questions and the assessment criteria with their weightings.

requirements.text: A round can only be opened after its programme manager has approved its set-up, and the system records who approved it and when.
requirements.quote: A round shall only be opened once its programme manager has approved its set-up, and the system shall record who approved it and when.

requirements.text: The rounds' budgets in a programme in one financial year must not add up to more than the programme's budget for that year.
requirements.quote: The system shall not allow the budget of the rounds in a programme in one financial year to exceed the programme's budget for that year.

requirements.text: A grants officer can copy a previous round as the starting point for a new one.
requirements.quote: A grants officer shall be able to copy a previous round as the starting point for a new one.

requirements.text: In an invitation-only round, only invited organisations can start an application.
requirements.quote: for an invitation-only round, the system shall only let invited organisations start an application.

requirements.text: No applications are accepted after the round's closing date and time, and an application still being completed at closing cannot be submitted.
requirements.quote: Applications shall not be accepted after a round's closing date and time, and an application that is being completed when the round closes shall not be submittable.

requirements.text: The programme manager can extend the closing date for a single applicant, recording the reason, and the extension appears in the round's audit history.
requirements.quote: The programme manager shall be able to extend the closing date for a single applicant, recording the reason, and the extension shall be shown in the round's audit history.

requirements.text: A person can register an organisation by giving its name, address, legal form, charity or company number if it has one, and details of at least two unrelated people connected with it.
requirements.quote: A person shall be able to register an organisation in the system by giving its name, address, legal form, charity or company number if it has one, and the details of at least two people connected with it who are not related to each other.

requirements.text: Where a charity or company number is given, the system checks it against the public register and shows the officer any differences in name and address.
requirements.quote: Where a charity or company number is given, the system shall check it against the public register and shall show the officer any difference between the registered name and address and those entered.

requirements.text: The system prevents registering an organisation whose charity or company number is already on another record and directs the person to request access to the existing record.
requirements.quote: The system shall prevent the registration of an organisation whose charity or company number is already held on another organisation record, and shall direct the person to request access to the existing record.

requirements.text: An organisation record can have several users, and existing users approve any request by a new user to join.
requirements.quote: An organisation record shall be able to have several users, and the organisation's existing users shall approve any request by a new user to join it.

requirements.text: If no remaining user can approve a join request, a grants officer can add a user after verifying the person's connection with the organisation.
requirements.quote: If an organisation has no remaining users who can approve a request, a grants officer shall be able to add a user after verifying the person's connection with the organisation.

requirements.text: An organisation uploads its governing document, accounts, safeguarding policy and equality policy once, and the system attaches the current versions to each application automatically.
requirements.quote: An organisation shall be able to upload its governing document, latest accounts, safeguarding policy and equality policy to its organisation record once, and the system shall attach the current versions to each application automatically.

requirements.text: The system records an expiry date for each organisation document and asks for a new version when one expires.
requirements.quote: The system shall record an expiry date for each organisation document and shall ask the organisation to upload a new version when one expires.

requirements.text: Accounts are treated as expired 18 months after the end of the financial year they cover.
requirements.quote: Accounts shall be treated as expired 18 months after the end of the financial year they cover.

requirements.text: An organisation enters its bank details, and the system verifies the account name matches the organisation's name using the council's bank account verification service before the details can be used for a payment.
requirements.quote: An organisation shall enter its bank details in the system, and the system shall verify that the account name matches the organisation's name using the council's bank account verification service before the details can be used for a payment.

requirements.text: A change to bank details only takes effect after a grants officer confirms it by telephone with a connected person using a number already on the record, and the system records who called and when.
requirements.quote: A change to an organisation's bank details shall only take effect after a grants officer has confirmed it by telephone with a person connected with the organisation, using a telephone number already held on the record, and the system shall record who made the call and when.

requirements.text: No payment is released to bank details changed in the previous 10 working days until a finance officer has reviewed the change.
requirements.quote: No payment shall be released to bank details that were changed in the previous 10 working days until a finance officer has reviewed the change.

requirements.text: Before applying, the applicant answers the round's eligibility questions and is told immediately whether they are eligible and, if not, which answer made them ineligible.
requirements.quote: Before starting an application, an applicant shall answer the round's eligibility questions, and the system shall tell them immediately whether they are eligible, and if not, which answer made them ineligible.

requirements.text: An ineligible applicant is shown the contact details of the grants team and of the local umbrella body.
requirements.quote: An applicant who is not eligible shall be shown the contact details of the grants team and of the local umbrella body that can offer advice.

requirements.text: The system prevents an organisation applying to a round if it has an overdue monitoring report on any previous grant.
requirements.quote: The system shall prevent an organisation from applying to a round if it has an overdue monitoring report on any previous grant.

requirements.text: An organisation cannot hold more than one open application to the same round.
requirements.quote: An organisation shall not hold more than one open application to the same round.

requirements.text: The application form saves answers automatically, and the applicant can leave and return at any time before the round closes.
requirements.quote: The application form shall save the applicant's answers automatically as they are entered, and the applicant shall be able to leave and return to the application at any time before the round closes.

requirements.text: Several users of an organisation can work on an application but only one can edit at a time, and the system shows who is editing.
requirements.quote: Several users of the same organisation shall be able to work on an application, but only one shall be able to edit it at a time, and the system shall show who is editing.

requirements.text: The application includes a budget table of items, costs and capital or revenue, and the system calculates the total and checks it equals the amount requested.
requirements.quote: The application shall include a budget table in which the applicant lists each item of expenditure, its cost and whether it is capital or revenue, and the system shall calculate the total and check that it equals the amount requested.

requirements.text: An application cannot request less than the round's minimum or more than its maximum grant.
requirements.quote: The system shall not allow an application to request less than the round's minimum or more than its maximum grant.

requirements.text: Before submitting, the applicant confirms a declaration that the information is true, and the system records who confirmed it and when.
requirements.quote: Before submitting, the applicant shall confirm a declaration that the information given is true, and the system shall record the name of the person who confirmed it and the date and time.

requirements.text: On submission the system emails an acknowledgement with a reference number and the date a decision is expected.
requirements.quote: When an application is submitted the system shall send the applicant an acknowledgement by email with a reference number and the date by which a decision is expected.

requirements.text: A grants officer can complete and submit an application for an applicant who cannot apply online, recording that they did so and the applicant's confirmation of the declaration.
requirements.quote: A grants officer shall be able to complete and submit an application on behalf of an applicant who cannot apply online, recording that they did so and the applicant's confirmation of the declaration.

requirements.text: The Youth Voice application form uses plain language suitable for ages 13 to 25 and lets a group of young people apply with a named adult.
requirements.quote: The Youth Voice fund application form shall use plain language suitable for applicants aged 13 to 25, and shall allow a group of young people to apply with the support of a named adult.

requirements.text: The application process should be quick to complete for small grants.
requirements.quote: The application process should be quick to complete for small grants.

requirements.text: A grants officer can allocate applications to assessors.
requirements.quote: A grants officer shall be able to allocate applications to assessors

requirements.text: Two independent assessors are required for any application requesting more than 10,000.
requirements.quote: the system shall require two independent assessors for any application requesting more than 10,000.

requirements.text: Assessors declare any interest before seeing an application, and an assessor declaring an interest cannot see or score it.
requirements.quote: Before an assessor can see an application, they shall declare whether they have any interest in the applicant organisation, and an assessor who declares an interest shall not be able to see or score the application.

requirements.text: Every declaration of interest, including no interest, is recorded with date and person.
requirements.quote: The system shall record every declaration of interest, including declarations of no interest, with the date and the person who made it.

requirements.text: External volunteer assessors only see applications allocated to them and cannot see bank details or other assessors' scores.
requirements.quote: External volunteer assessors shall only see the applications allocated to them and shall not see the organisation's bank details or the scores of other assessors.

requirements.text: Assessors score each criterion on the round's scale with a comment, and the system calculates the weighted total.
requirements.quote: An assessor shall score each criterion on a scale defined for the round and shall write a comment for each score, and the system shall calculate the weighted total.

requirements.text: The system flags an application for moderation where two assessors' weighted totals differ by more than 20% of the maximum score.
requirements.quote: Where the weighted totals given by two assessors differ by more than 20% of the maximum score, the system shall flag the application for moderation.

requirements.text: The moderated score and reason for any change are recorded, and the assessors' original scores are kept.
requirements.quote: The moderated score and the reason for any change from the assessors' scores shall be recorded, and the assessors' original scores shall be kept.

requirements.text: A grants officer carries out and records due diligence on every application recommended for funding before it goes to the decision-maker, including accounts, governing document and, for grants over 25,000, a credit check.
requirements.quote: A grants officer shall carry out due diligence on every application recommended for funding before it goes to the decision-maker, recording the checks made and their outcome.

requirements.text: Due diligence includes checking accounts and governing document and, for grants over 25,000, a credit check.
requirements.quote: Due diligence includes checking the organisation's accounts, its governing document and, for grants over 25,000, a credit check.

requirements.text: The system routes each recommended application to the decision-maker required by the scheme of delegation, based on the grant's total value over its whole term.
requirements.quote: The system shall route each recommended application to the decision-maker required by the scheme of delegation, based on the total value of the grant over its whole term.

requirements.text: A grants officer decides grants up to 5,000.
requirements.quote: A grants officer can decide on grants of up to 5,000 under delegated authority.

requirements.text: The programme's grant panel decides grants from 5,001 to 25,000.
requirements.quote: The programme's grant panel decides on grants from 5,001 to 25,000.

requirements.text: The Cabinet member for communities decides grants from 25,001 to 100,000.
requirements.quote: The Cabinet member for communities decides on grants from 25,001 to 100,000.

requirements.text: Cabinet decides grants over 100,000.
requirements.quote: Cabinet decides on grants over 100,000.

requirements.text: For multi-year Strategic Partnerships grants, the total over all years determines the decision-maker.
requirements.quote: For multi-year Strategic Partnerships grants, the total over all years determines the decision-maker.

requirements.text: A panel member with an interest declares it before the panel meets, and the system excludes them from the decision.
requirements.quote: A grant panel member who has an interest in an application shall declare it before the panel meets, and the system shall exclude them from the decision on that application.

requirements.text: Each decision is recorded as approved, approved with conditions or declined, with decision-maker, date, amount and reasons.
requirements.quote: The system shall record each decision as approved, approved with conditions, or declined, with the decision-maker, the date, the amount approved and the reasons.

requirements.text: Total approved in a round cannot exceed the round's budget, and the decision-maker sees remaining budget before each decision.
requirements.quote: The total approved in a round shall not exceed the round's budget, and the system shall show the decision-maker the remaining budget before each decision.

requirements.text: Every applicant is told the decision by email within five working days, and declined applicants receive the assessors' comments.
requirements.quote: Every applicant shall be told the decision on their application by email within five working days of the decision, and declined applicants shall be given the assessors' comments as feedback.

requirements.text: Decisions on grants over 25,000 are published on the website showing organisation, amount and purpose.
requirements.quote: Decisions on grants over 25,000 shall be published on the council's website, showing the organisation, the amount and the purpose.

requirements.text: Each ward member can see their remaining allocation and recommend a grant to an eligible organisation for a project in their ward.
requirements.quote: Each ward member shall be able to see their remaining allocation for the year and recommend a grant to an eligible organisation for a project in their ward.

requirements.text: A ward member cannot recommend a grant to an organisation in which they have a declared interest in the register of members' interests.
requirements.quote: A ward member shall not be able to recommend a grant to an organisation in which they have declared an interest in the council's register of members' interests.

requirements.text: A grants officer checks every Ward Member Grant recommendation and approves or rejects it; a rejection returns the amount to the member's allocation.
requirements.quote: A grants officer shall check every Ward Member Grant recommendation for eligibility and shall approve or reject it, and a rejected recommendation shall return the amount to the member's allocation.

requirements.text: Ward Member Grants cannot be recommended in the six weeks before a local election.
requirements.quote: Ward Member Grants shall not be recommended in the six weeks before a local election.

requirements.text: On approval the system generates a grant agreement from the programme template with amount, purpose, conditions, payment schedule and monitoring requirements.
requirements.quote: When a grant is approved, the system shall generate a grant agreement from the template for the programme, including the amount, the purpose, any conditions set by the decision-maker, the payment schedule and the monitoring requirements.

requirements.text: The recipient signs electronically through the system, and two connected people sign for grants over 5,000.
requirements.quote: The grant recipient shall sign the grant agreement electronically through the system, and the agreement shall be signed by two people connected with the organisation for grants over 5,000.

requirements.text: No payment is made until the recipient has signed and the council has countersigned the agreement.
requirements.quote: No payment shall be made on a grant until the grant agreement has been signed by the recipient and countersigned by the council.

requirements.text: A grant offer lapses if the agreement is not signed within a reasonable time, and the amount returns to the round's budget.
requirements.quote: An offer of a grant shall lapse if the agreement is not signed within a reasonable time, and the amount shall be returned to the round's budget.

requirements.text: Grants up to 10,000 are paid in a single payment after signing; grants over 10,000 are paid in instalments per the payment schedule.
requirements.quote: Grants up to 10,000 shall be paid in a single payment after the agreement is signed, and grants over 10,000 shall be paid in instalments set out in the payment schedule.

requirements.text: For Strategic Partnerships, instalments after the first are released only once the previous quarter's monitoring report is accepted.
requirements.quote: For Strategic Partnerships grants, instalments after the first shall only be released once the previous quarter's monitoring report has been accepted.

requirements.text: When a payment is due and conditions are met, the system creates a payment request with grant reference, amount, cost centre and verified bank details.
requirements.quote: When a payment is due under the payment schedule and its conditions have been met, the system shall create a payment request containing the grant reference, the amount, the cost centre and the recipient's verified bank details.

requirements.text: A finance officer reviews and releases each payment request, and the officer who approved the grant cannot release its payment.
requirements.quote: A finance officer shall review each payment request and release it to the finance system, and the system shall prevent the officer who approved the grant from releasing its payment.

requirements.text: The system records the payment date and finance system reference when Finance confirms payment.
requirements.quote: The system shall record the payment date and the finance system reference when Finance confirms that a payment has been made.

requirements.text: The system automatically stops a payment request if the recipient's registration shows removed, dissolved or insolvent.
requirements.quote: The system shall stop a payment request automatically if the recipient organisation's charity or company registration shows it as removed, dissolved or in insolvency.

requirements.text: A recipient can request a variation through the system, explaining what and why.
requirements.quote: A recipient shall be able to request a variation to their grant through the system, explaining what they want to change and why.

requirements.text: A variation changing the grant amount is decided by the decision-maker required for the new total.
requirements.quote: A variation that changes the amount of the grant shall be decided by the decision-maker who would be required for the new total amount.

requirements.text: A variation moving less than 10% of the grant between budget items without changing the total is decided by a grants officer.
requirements.quote: A variation that moves less than 10% of the grant between budget items, without changing the total, shall be decided by a grants officer.

requirements.text: Every variation is recorded against the agreement, keeping both the original signed agreement and the varied one.
requirements.quote: Every variation shall be recorded against the grant agreement, and the system shall keep the agreement as originally signed as well as the agreement as varied.

requirements.text: Recipients of grants up to 5,000 submit a single end-of-grant report.
requirements.quote: Recipients of grants up to 5,000 submit a single end-of-grant report.

requirements.text: Recipients of grants from 5,001 to 25,000 submit a mid-point report and an end-of-grant report.
requirements.quote: Recipients of grants from 5,001 to 25,000 submit a mid-point report and an end-of-grant report.

requirements.text: Recipients of grants over 25,000 submit quarterly reports and an end-of-grant report with evidence of expenditure.
requirements.quote: Recipients of grants over 25,000 submit quarterly reports and an end-of-grant report with evidence of expenditure.

requirements.text: The system reminds the recipient 14 days before and on the due date, and marks a report overdue if not submitted within 14 days after the due date.
requirements.quote: The system shall remind the recipient of each monitoring report 14 days before it is due and again on the due date, and shall mark the report as overdue if it is not submitted within 14 days after the due date.

requirements.text: A grants officer reviews each monitoring report, records whether it is accepted, and may ask for more information.
requirements.quote: A grants officer shall review each monitoring report and record whether it is accepted, and may ask the recipient for more information.

requirements.text: Monitoring reports collect the outcome measures set for the round.
requirements.quote: Monitoring reports shall collect the outcome measures set for the round, so that the council can report the outcomes achieved across all grants in a programme.

requirements.text: A grants officer can start a clawback recording amount and reason, and the system sends a repayment request.
requirements.quote: a grants officer shall be able to start a clawback, recording the amount to be recovered and the reason, and the system shall send a request for repayment to the recipient.

requirements.text: A clawback over 5,000 must be approved by the programme manager before the repayment request is sent.
requirements.quote: A clawback over 5,000 shall be approved by the programme manager before the request for repayment is sent.

requirements.text: A grant is closed when the end-of-grant report is accepted and all payments and any clawback are completed.
requirements.quote: A grant shall be closed when the end-of-grant report has been accepted and every payment and any clawback has been completed.

requirements.text: The system reports grants awarded and paid by programme, round, ward and organisation for any period.
requirements.quote: The system shall report, for any period, the grants awarded and paid by programme, round, ward and organisation.

requirements.text: The system shows, for any organisation, every application and grant across all programmes.
requirements.quote: The system shall show, for any organisation, every application it has made and every grant it has received from the council across all programmes.

requirements.text: The system reports applications received, approved and declined per round with decline reasons, by ward and by equality information.
requirements.quote: The system shall report the applications received, approved and declined in each round, with the reasons for declining, by ward and by the equality information applicants provided.

requirements.text: Each ward member can see grants awarded in their ward under all programmes.
requirements.quote: Each ward member shall be able to see the grants awarded in their ward under all programmes.

requirements.text: Auditors have read-only access to every record in the system.
requirements.quote: Auditors shall be able to see every record in the system, including declarations of interest, decisions, bank detail changes and their verification, without being able to change anything.

requirements.text: Applicant-facing parts meet WCAG 2.2 AA and work on mobile phones as well as computers.
requirements.quote: The applicant-facing parts of the system shall meet the WCAG 2.2 AA standard and shall work on mobile phones as well as on computers.

requirements.text: A first-time applicant with documents to hand can complete an application for a grant under 1,000 in no more than 30 minutes.
requirements.quote: The application process for a grant under 1,000 shall be completable in no more than 30 minutes by a first-time applicant who has their organisation documents to hand.

requirements.text: The system is available at least 99.5% of the time, with no planned maintenance in the last 48 hours before a round closes.
requirements.quote: The system shall be available at least 99.5% of the time, and in the last 48 hours before a round closes it shall have no planned maintenance.

requirements.text: The system supports at least 500 concurrent applicants with no page taking more than three seconds to load.
requirements.quote: The system shall support at least 500 applicants working on applications at the same time without a page taking more than three seconds to load.

requirements.text: Council users sign in with single sign-on; applicants and external assessors use email, password and a second factor.
requirements.quote: Council users shall sign in with the council's single sign-on, and applicants and external assessors shall sign in with an email address, a password and a second factor.

requirements.text: A grants officer can remove personal data of service users included by mistake without deleting the rest of the application.
requirements.quote: Personal data about applicants' service users, if any is included in an application by mistake, shall be removable by a grants officer without deleting the rest of the application.

requirements.text: Approved grant records are kept seven years after closure and declined application records two years after the decision, then deleted.
requirements.quote: The system shall retain records of approved grants for seven years after the grant is closed and records of declined applications for two years after the decision, and shall then delete them.

requirements.text: Equality information is optional, kept separately from the application, and not visible to assessors or decision-makers.
requirements.quote: Equality information given by applicants shall be optional, shall be kept separately from the application, and shall not be visible to assessors or decision-makers.

requirements.text: Every change to a record is logged with user, date and time and before and after values, and the audit record cannot be edited or deleted by any user.
requirements.quote: Every action that changes a record in the system shall be recorded with the user, the date and time, and the value before and after the change, and the audit record shall not be editable or deletable by any user.

requirements.text: Grants from the three financial years before go-live are migrated with organisation, amount, programme and status.
requirements.quote: Grants made in the three financial years before go-live shall be migrated into the system with their organisation, amount, programme and status, so that reports of funding to an organisation are complete.

requirements.text: Organisation records that appear to be the same are presented to a grants officer for a merge decision before migration.
requirements.quote: Before migration, organisation records that appear to refer to the same organisation shall be presented to a grants officer for a decision on whether to merge them.

requirements.text: In-progress Strategic Partnerships grants are migrated with agreements, payment schedules and monitoring reports.
requirements.quote: Strategic Partnerships grants that are in progress at go-live shall be migrated with their agreements, payment schedules and monitoring reports, so that they can be managed in the system from go-live.

requirements.text: The system must allow each programme's own rules to be applied without affecting other programmes.
requirements.quote: The system must allow these rules to be applied for the programme concerned without affecting other programmes.

requirements.text: A Neighbourhood Fund application records the neighbourhood served, and the system adds the round's priority weighting to scores from priority neighbourhoods.
requirements.quote: A Neighbourhood Fund application shall record the neighbourhood the project serves, chosen from the council's list of neighbourhoods, and the system shall add the priority weighting set for the round to the weighted score of applications from priority neighbourhoods.

requirements.text: An organisation cannot receive more than one Neighbourhood Fund grant in the same financial year.
requirements.quote: An organisation shall not receive more than one Neighbourhood Fund grant in the same financial year.

requirements.text: A Strategic Partnerships agreement states years two and three are subject to the annual budget, and the programme manager must confirm each year's funding before its first instalment.
requirements.quote: A Strategic Partnerships grant agreement shall state that the second and third years' funding is subject to the council's annual budget, and the system shall require the programme manager to confirm each year's funding before its first instalment is released.

requirements.text: Each Strategic Partnerships grant has a named relationship manager, and a note of each quarterly meeting is recorded.
requirements.quote: Each Strategic Partnerships grant shall have a named relationship manager, and the system shall record a note of each quarterly meeting against the grant.

requirements.text: For Small Sparks grants paid via a sponsor, the system records the sponsor, verifies its bank details and requires the sponsor to sign the agreement as well as the group.
requirements.quote: Where a Small Sparks grant is paid through a sponsoring organisation, the system shall record the sponsor, verify the sponsor's bank details in the same way as a recipient's, and require the sponsor to sign the grant agreement as well as the group.

requirements.text: A Small Sparks decision is made within ten working days of submission, and the system alerts the programme manager about applications undecided after eight working days.
requirements.quote: A decision on a Small Sparks application shall be made within ten working days of submission, and the system shall alert the programme manager about any application still undecided after eight working days.

requirements.text: The system records that a Youth Voice assessor is a youth panel member and the name of the supporting youth worker.
requirements.quote: Assessors for the Youth Voice fund may be members of the youth council aged 16 or over, and the system shall record that an assessor is a youth panel member and the name of the supporting youth worker.

requirements.text: An Arts in the Open grant is not paid until the event permission is uploaded, and the system records the permission reference.
requirements.quote: An Arts in the Open grant shall not be paid until the applicant has uploaded the event permission from the council's events team, and the system shall record the permission reference.

requirements.text: If an Arts in the Open event is cancelled for bad weather, a grants officer can record a partial clawback of the remainder.
requirements.quote: the system shall allow a grants officer to record a partial clawback of the remainder.

requirements.text: Winter Warmth grants are approved only for activities between 1 November and 31 March, and the end-of-grant report is due by 30 April.
requirements.quote: Winter Warmth grants shall only be approved for activities that take place between 1 November and 31 March, and the end-of-grant report shall be due by 30 April.

questions.text: The text says grants officers sometimes extend deadlines for individual applicants, but the requirement gives this power only to the programme manager. Can grants officers also extend deadlines, or only the programme manager?
questions.quote: Grants officers sometimes extend the deadline for an individual applicant who had technical problems.

questions.text: What does 'related to each other' mean for the two people connected with an organisation (family, household, marriage or partnership)? What counts as 'connected with' the organisation, and how will the system or officer check this?
questions.quote: the details of at least two people connected with it who are not related to each other.

questions.text: Bank detail changes must be confirmed by phone using a number already on the record. What happens if the record has no telephone number, or the number is the one that has just changed?
questions.quote: using a telephone number already held on the record

questions.text: 'Quick to complete' is not measurable and overlaps with the 30-minute limit for grants under 1,000. What measurable target applies to small grants, and what is a small grant here?
questions.quote: The application process should be quick to complete for small grants.

questions.text: The document says Small Sparks grants are up to 1,000 in section 1.1, but up to 1,500 (from 100) in Appendix A. Which is correct, and what minimum and maximum should the round be configured with?
questions.quote: Small Sparks grants range from 100 to 1,500

questions.text: Interests are handled for assessors and panel members only. What applies to decision-makers who are not panels (a grants officer, the Cabinet member, Cabinet), and how is a declaration made and enforced for them?
questions.quote: A grant panel member who has an interest in an application shall declare it before the panel meets, and the system shall exclude them from the decision on that application.

questions.text: How long is a 'reasonable time' for signing an agreement before an offer lapses? Section 16.2 says Legal Services have not yet advised. Is it a fixed period, configurable per programme, or open-ended until then?
questions.quote: An offer of a grant shall lapse if the agreement is not signed within a reasonable time, and the amount shall be returned to the round's budget.

questions.text: Is 10% measured against the whole grant or the current year's grant (the example uses the year's grant)? Who decides a variation that moves 10% or more between budget items without changing the total?
questions.quote: A variation that moves less than 10% of the grant between budget items, without changing the total, shall be decided by a grants officer.

questions.text: Records must be deleted after set periods, yet the audit record can never be deleted. Does retention apply to the audit history? What retention applies to organisation records, withdrawn or ineligible applications, and declarations of interest?
questions.quote: The system shall retain records of approved grants for seven years after the grant is closed and records of declined applications for two years after the decision, and shall then delete them.

questions.text: Over what period is 99.5% availability measured, and is planned maintenance excluded from the calculation?
questions.quote: The system shall be available at least 99.5% of the time

questions.text: Youth Voice assessors must be aged 16 or over, but the panel includes under-18s whose role in decisions is unresolved. Can under-18s take part in decisions, and must an adult record them? What should the system be built to do?
questions.quote: The Youth Voice fund panel includes young people who are under 18. Legal Services are considering whether they can take part in decisions recorded in the system or whether an adult must record the decision for them.

questions.text: What income threshold will exempt small organisations from providing accounts, and how does this interact with the accounts upload, expiry and due diligence requirements?
questions.quote: Programme managers have suggested that small organisations with an annual income below a threshold should not have to provide accounts, but the threshold has not been set.

questions.text: Is the system required to notify ward members when an organisation in their ward applies to any programme? If so, what does it notify and when? If not, should this be excluded?
questions.quote: Some ward members have asked to be told when an organisation in their ward applies to any programme; no decision has been made.

requirements.text: The PMS remains the system of record for appointments, with the portal reading availability from it and writing bookings back to it.
requirements.quote: The PMS remains the system of record for appointments.

requirements.text: The portal must use the integration interface exposed by the PMS vendor to connect to the PMS.
requirements.quote: The PMS vendor exposes an integration interface that the portal will use; the technical details of that interface are outside the scope of this document.

requirements.text: The patient representative group of eleven volunteers will take part in usability testing of the portal.
requirements.quote: A patient representative group of eleven volunteers has reviewed the patient-facing parts of this document and will take part in usability testing.

requirements.text: The IT service desk will support the portal once it is live.
requirements.quote: the IT service desk that will support the portal once it is live

requirements.text: A booking made in the portal appears in the PMS immediately, in the same appointment book as telephone bookings, so the receptionist sees it there.
requirements.quote: The booking appears in the PMS immediately and the receptionist sees it in the same appointment book as a telephone booking.

requirements.text: The patient receives a booking confirmation and, nearer the time, a reminder that they can reply to in order to cancel.
requirements.quote: The patient receives a confirmation and, nearer the time, a reminder they can reply to if they need to cancel.

requirements.text: A cancelled slot is offered automatically to waiting-list patients who said they could attend at that time.
requirements.quote: A cancelled slot is offered automatically to patients on the waiting list who said they could attend at that time.

requirements.text: Telephone booking continues to be available for patients who prefer it, for urgent and same-day appointments, and for appointment types not offered online.
requirements.quote: Telephone booking will continue for patients who prefer it, for urgent and same-day appointments, and for appointment types that are not offered online.

requirements.text: Receptionists must be able to see, for any patient, whether the patient has a portal account and whether it is locked.
requirements.quote: Receptionists shall be able to see, for any patient, whether the patient has a portal account and whether it is locked, so that they can direct the patient appropriately.

requirements.text: The portal must not keep its own copy of the appointment book.
requirements.quote: The portal shall not keep its own copy of the appointment book;

requirements.text: The first release covers only routine, non-urgent appointment types that practice managers have marked as bookable online.
requirements.quote: The first release covers routine, non-urgent appointment types that the practice managers have marked as bookable online.

requirements.text: Each site can choose which of its appointment types are offered online.
requirements.quote: Each site may choose which of its appointment types are offered online.

requirements.text: The first release provides patient sign-in, viewing availability, booking, rescheduling and cancelling appointments, appointment reminders, a waiting list for cancelled slots, carer access for dependants, a staff view of online activity, and the reports described in section 8.
requirements.quote: The first release includes patient sign-in, viewing availability, booking, rescheduling and cancelling appointments, appointment reminders, a waiting list for cancelled slots, carer access for dependants, a staff view of online activity, and the reports described in section 8.

requirements.text: Only patients already registered at one of the six clinics can use the portal; registration is not done through the portal.
requirements.quote: Patients must already be registered at one of the six clinics to use the portal.

requirements.text: A registered patient can create a portal account by verifying identity against PMS details using date of birth, surname, postcode and a one-time code sent to the mobile number held in the PMS.
requirements.quote: A registered patient shall be able to create a portal account by verifying their identity against the details held in the PMS, using their date of birth, surname, postcode and a one-time code sent to the mobile number held in the PMS.

requirements.text: If no mobile number is recorded in the PMS, the portal tells the patient to contact their clinic and offers no other online identity verification method.
requirements.quote: If a patient has no mobile number recorded in the PMS, the portal shall tell the patient to contact their clinic and shall not offer any other way to verify their identity online.

requirements.text: Patients sign in with an email address and password.
requirements.quote: A patient shall sign in with an email address and password, and the portal shall require a second factor on every sign-in from a device it has not seen before.

requirements.text: The portal requires a second factor on every sign-in from a device it has not seen before, and only on such devices.
requirements.quote: the portal shall require a second factor on every sign-in from a device it has not seen before.

requirements.text: The portal locks an account after five consecutive failed sign-in attempts.
requirements.quote: The portal shall lock an account after five consecutive failed sign-in attempts and shall unlock it automatically after thirty minutes.

requirements.text: A locked account unlocks automatically after thirty minutes.
requirements.quote: The portal shall lock an account after five consecutive failed sign-in attempts and shall unlock it automatically after thirty minutes.

requirements.text: Front-desk staff cannot manually unlock accounts in the first release.
requirements.quote: Front-desk staff will not be able to unlock accounts manually in the first release;

requirements.text: A signed-in session ends after a period of inactivity, and the patient is warned before it ends.
requirements.quote: A signed-in session shall end after a period of inactivity, and the patient shall be warned before it ends.

requirements.text: A carer must be able to book, reschedule and cancel appointments for any dependant linked to their account.

requirements.quote: A patient who cannot find a suitable slot shall be able to join a waiting list for a chosen appointment type and site, stating the days of the week and times of day they could attend.

requirements.quote: The portal shall provide a monthly report for each site showing the number of appointments booked, moved and cancelled online, the number of reminders sent, and the number of missed appointments for online and telephone bookings separately.

requirements.quote: Availability searches shall return results within three seconds for 95% of requests at peak load.
